title: Why Your Link In Bio Should Be A Merch Store
desc: Give fans a place to buy: a DIGITVL store with your own free address, ready for your bio.

sentences.text: Your link in bio is prime real estate.
Point it at your own store, at artistname.digitvl.com
Every post, every video, every story can lead to one place.
Fans see your logo on real products, not a list of links.
You pick the products, set the prices, and approve the store.
Printing and shipping happen only when someone orders.
Make your link do more at stores.digitvl.com
One link. Real products. A store that's yours.
